title: Make the home page champion banner derive from current season data
description:
`website/src/pages/index.astro` currently hardcodes Season 1 championship data:
- It reads `data/tournaments/season-1.json` directly.
- It links the banner to `/season/1/results`.
- It hardcodes the copy `Season 1 Champion`.

At the same time, the page already reads `website/src/data/season.json` for `current_season` and `phase`. So the page has two competing sources of truth.

This is not broken yet because `season.json` still says `current_season: 1`, but it is staged to go stale as soon as season 2 starts or the tournament pointer moves. The fix should derive the banner data from `season.json` or from the configured tournament path rather than hardcoding Season 1 paths and labels.
